content.title: Get 3 months of Apple TV for free.
content.text: You’ll get three months for free when you buy a new Apple TV 4K, iPhone, iPad or Mac.1 Apple TV features new Apple Originals every month. All are available on demand, and one subscription includes access for up to six family members at no additional cost. Watch in stunning 4K HDR with Dolby Atmos sound.2 Download whatever you want and watch offline. Redeem 3 months of free Apple TV now. You can start your free three-month subscription to Apple TV after setting up your new Apple product. Here’s how to redeem your offer. Turn on your new Apple device and sign in with your Apple ID. Open the Apple TV app. Make sure your device is running the latest version of tvOS, iOS, iPadOS or macOS. The offer should be presented immediately after you launch the app. If not, go to the Apple TV tab, where you’ll see the offer. Tap Enjoy 3 Months Free. Watch Apple TV on your favourite devices. Enjoy Apple TV on the Apple TV app, which is already on your favourite Apple devices as well as streaming platforms, popular smart TVs, gaming consoles and AirPlay‑enabled devices. Or watch on the web at tv.apple.com. See all the ways to watch Apple TV In case you missed anything.
